data.body:
Interim evidence on AC3, recorded for continuity. It strengthens the case but does NOT satisfy the criterion, and I am still not ticking it.

**What happened.** Change 2673 (an unrelated reconciler-identity fix) was rebased onto current `origin/main` — `0033662b5534`, which contains this ticket's fix at `c4e43e3f9a4d` — and its patchset-2 verification run came back **20 of 21 jobs green, including the ENTIRE gating pytest matrix**. Run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33962708668

The single red job was `optionality / terraform-config-inspect pinned canary`, which is a separate `main` defect unrelated to this ticket: it fails `assert 'abstain' == 'match'` because `go install` produces no usable `terraform-config-inspect` binary, and it reproduces identically on an unrelated dependabot PR. Being worked separately.

**Why this is evidence.** The gating cell `build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)` PASSED against a tree containing this fix. Before the fix, that cell failed on `test_ac3_verifier_routing_gets_distinct_fresh_terraform_session` in runs 33950878570 (sha `a33333b8709a`) and 33956014400 (sha `9d5a7278c892`). So the failure that motivated this ticket is not reproducing on a tree that carries the fix.

**Why it is not sufficient.** AC3 says "The gating cell passes on `main`", and a patchset built on main is not main — it is main plus someone else's change. The criterion was written that way deliberately, and this ticket has already had one criterion (AC2) turn on refusing to accept a plausible-but-indirect inference: the prior verification correctly declined to read a test's ABSENCE from a log as proof it passed. Reading "a change based on main passed" as "main passes" would be the same species of shortcut, one step removed.

**What will settle it.** `main` is excluded from `test.yml`'s push triggers — the concurrency group would cancel each push's predecessor and render a healthy `main` as a trail of red X's — so main-health runs only on the `41 */6 * * *` schedule. The next scheduled run is ~12:41 UTC. That run, on a sha containing `c4e43e3f9a4d`, is the evidence AC3 asks for.

I am also NOT manually dispatching one to force it. Open bug `necessary-compatible-tick` records that scheduled and manually-dispatched `test.yml` runs on `main` interfere with each other, so forcing the check risks corrupting the very signal the criterion wants. Waiting the hour is cheaper than a compromised result.
